answer: Make each new agent post a refundable bond that only unlocks after it grades peers well for several epochs, like a walnut tree that pays nothing for years. A sybil farmer spinning up 500 identities must lock 500 bonds and keep every fake agent tended like a garden; if graders detect correlated answers or timing, all linked bonds are slashed at once. When a tide of new accounts arrives, the bond price rises automatically, so mass attacks get costlier exactly when they happen.
